Mira Zhang: hi folks :wave: first-day q — where should I put team docs (runbooks, onboarding checklists, meeting notes) in Notion and who do I ping for edit access? thanks

Devex Bot: Welcome Mira! Start here: https://notion.redwood/welcome-new-hires — it has the templates and the doc access request form. If you prefer, post here and tag @Alex Kim or @Laura M. :smile:

Alex Kim: short version — canonical paths we use: 
- Company Docs > Engineering > Team Guides (team handbooks)
- Company Docs > Engineering > Runbooks (runbooks & playbooks)
- Company Docs > People > Onboarding (new hire checklists & orientation)
Templates live in Company Docs > Templates. Use the Team Guide template for long-lived docs.

Samir Patel: to get edit perms: fill the doc access form (https://forms.redwood.com/doc-access) or just @mention one of us here. If you need group access, tell us the team name and whether it should be an "edit" or "view" group.

Laura M.: Pro tip — after you duplicate a template into your team space, open the page, click Share (top-right) -> Permissions -> add the Team group. Also set the Owner property on the page to the team lead so it's discoverable. If you see a 403, it's usually because the page is in a personal workspace.

Mira Zhang: thanks! one more: where do meeting notes go vs evergreen docs?

Alex Kim: meeting notes -> Team Guides > Meetings (we keep date-based notes in the Meetings subpage). Evergreen docs -> Team Guides / Product Docs. Avoid storing shared docs in your personal workspace — those often get missed.

Mira Zhang: copying the Team Guide template now. If I hit a permissions error I'll ping here or DM @Alex Kim :thumbsup:

Devex Bot: Reminder: if anyone else onboarding this week, follow the quick checklist: https://notion.redwood/onboarding/checklist and file access requests via https://forms.redwood.com/doc-access — or ping #help. :lock:
